brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level fabric string is 'CORDURA / Challenge Outdoor / X-Pac VX42, yellow nylon packcloth interior'. Photo evidence is thin here (9 images across 7 products, several products with only 1 shot), so this is treated as plausible-but-lightly-verified rather than confirmed. The BarBar Bag's red shell shows a faint diagonal quilt line consistent with X-Pac; the ATM Top Tube Bag's blue and Rear TT Sack's olive shells read as a plain coated Cordura-weight canvas with no visible diamond grid; the two camo frame bags (Custom Frame Bag, Gravel Banger) are printed camo fabric where a grid would be hard to see either way. Not enough evidence to say the X-Pac claim is wrong, only that it's confirmed on one product (BarBar) and unconfirmed (not contradicted) on the rest - same pattern Swift Industries showed.
brand_notes.photoThinness: Only the ATM Top Tube Bag, BarBar Bag and Granny's Pantry have more than one photo; Many Things Sack, Custom Frame Bag, Gravel Banger and Rear TT Sack each have exactly one. Several products (Granny's Pantry, Custom Frame Bag, Gravel Banger, Many Things Sack) have no published dimensions at all, so confidence is capped at medium/low across roughly half the line regardless of how clear the single photo is.

products.name: ATM Top Tube Bag
products.dims_note: Rigid zip bag with an internal plastic stiffener - single fixed figure, no range, so the printed inches convert straight across.

geometry.notes: Tall squared nose at the head-tube end tapering along the top-zip line to a low tail, flat bottom straddling the top tube. Rounded/padded top ridge along the zip run.

closure.hardware: single slider with a black pull tab, no storm flap

details.fabric: coated canvas, no visible X-Pac grid in this photo - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Two buckle straps around the top tube, one near the head tube and one further back; maker copy also lists bolt-on (oblong holes, Wolftooth B-Rad compatible) and a cable pass-through at the front lower corner (not visible in this crop).

products.name: Rear TT Sack
products.dims_note: No dimensions or litre figure published. The single side-elevation photo confirms the proportions are right for a stubby wedge (fills the triangle behind the saddle between seat tube and top tube), but the absolute scale (15x6x10cm) is an estimate matching the maker copy's 'a phone, wallet, and some snacks', not maker data. Same sub-type as Restrap's Rear Top Tube Bag - the usual fore-aft-elongation check does not apply to this shape.

geometry.notes: Short, stubby wedge - proportionally much shorter front-to-back than the front-mounted ATM bag since it only fills the small triangle behind the saddle. Single top zip along the sloped edge.

details.fabric: coated canvas, no visible X-Pac grid in this photo - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Two straps at the seat tube / top tube junction, rear-facing (opens toward the rider, behind the saddle) - opposite orientation from the front-mounted ATM Top Tube Bag. Sits ON TOP of the top tube, tucked under the nose of the saddle, strapping to both the top tube and the seatpost. An earlier record said hgt:-y, which the builder reads as hanging UNDER the tube, and it rendered down in the frame triangle over the bottle. Corrected on the owner s direct observation.

products.name: BarBar Bag (10")
products.dims_raw: It comes in two different widths, 8" and 10" with a diameter around 4".
products.dims_note: Fixed-diameter zip barrel, not a roll - len from the 10in width (bar-to-bar run), hgt/wid both the approximate 4in diameter. An 8in-wide version exists at the same diameter (not catalogued here).

geometry.notes: Straight fabric barrel, flat sewn end caps. Faint diagonal quilt stitch visible on the red shell, consistent with X-Pac.

closure.hardware: two sliders meeting centre-top, silver pulls, no storm flap - exposed zip

details.fabric: shows a faint diagonal quilt stitch consistent with X-Pac - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Two hook-and-loop strap-and-buckle mounts loop over the bar; a shock-cord toggle hangs off the bottom-centre of the bag in photo 2 to cinch down to the steerer/headset as a stabiliser, matching the maker copy's 'handlebar and head tube straps, adjustable positions'.

products.name: Many Things Sack v1.2
products.dims_raw: Standard 10" h x 6.5-5.5" tapered w x 3.5" d
products.dims_note: hgt is the fixed 10in (25.4cm) body height, no range on that axis. wid carries the LARGER end of the taper (6.5in=16.5cm at the cage-mouth/top) per the tapered-axis rule; the narrower 5.5in=14.0cm tail-end goes in geometry.taper. len is the fixed 3.5in (8.9cm) depth, front-to-back off the fork leg - this is the axis that previously made the CapsuleGeometry render as a sphere (negative length) because len, not hgt, was being treated as the long axis; hgt is correctly the long axis here.

geometry.notes: Upright rectangular sack, narrower at the base than the mouth, flat back sleeve against the fork leg/cage. A single triangular flap folds down over the top opening and is cinched by ONE vertical webbing strap with a side-release buckle running down the front centre - visually a fold-and-buckle flap, not a multi-turn roll, though the maker's own copy calls it a 'roll-top compression strap'. Diamond X-Pac quilt stitch visible on the black shell.

closure.hardware: single vertical webbing strap, front-centre side-release buckle, cinching a triangular fold-down flap; maker copy describes this as a 'roll-top compression strap' but the photo shows one fold, not a rolled closure

details.fabric: X-Pac, visible diamond quilt stitch on the black shell

mount.notes: PAIR VS SINGLE: catalogued size 'Standard (sold as a pair)' is a purchase-quantity option, not a two-in-one product - each sack is a single upright sleeve for ONE King Many Things Cage on ONE fork leg, and the maker sells singles, pairs and cage+bag bundles. capacity_l (3.4L) is PER BAG, matching MODEL-SPEC's pair-vs-single rule. SLOT CONFIRMED, not a pannier: the single photo shows no rack hooks, no rail clips and no wide flat panel - only side webbing loops for cage/strap retention and a front centre compression buckle, consistent with a cage-mounted sack that slides down over a triple-boss fork cage (4-point mount: cage sleeve + front strap through the lower cage loop + two velcro fork-leg straps per the maker copy). 'Pannier attachments' are listed on the maker's page as one optional extra, not the primary mount, which is likely the source of the pannier suspicion in HANDOVER.md.

products.name: Granny's Pantry
products.dims_note: No dimensions or litre figure published; maker copy calls it 'kinda like a small Rando Style bag but more stable and smaller' with a Klickfix bracket rated to 14lb. dims_cm is an unchanged estimate for a small rando bag, not maker data.

geometry.notes: Heather-grey box body with a lighter flat top panel, orange stretch/mesh pocket on the front face. Two black webbing compression bands wrap the body horizontally.

closure.hardware: flat lid flap with a carry handle loop; maker copy: 'shock cord closes the lid around the stem'

details.fabric: heather-grey coated canvas, no visible X-Pac grid in these photos - see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Klickfix quick-release bracket with an aluminium rail, visible on the top-rear of the bag in the on-bike photo (photo 2); a strap-mount version is also offered per the maker copy. Sits directly ahead of the stem, similar position to the Nuke Sunrise Silo but boxier and larger.

products.name: Full Single Compartment Custom Frame Bag
products.dims_note: Fully custom to a frame template; no dimensions or litre figure published. dims_cm is an unchanged mid-range full-triangle estimate, not maker data.

geometry.notes: Full main-triangle wedge in MultiCam-pattern fabric, tall squared nose at the head tube tapering to the seat tube/BB. Single straight zip runs along the sloped top edge. Loop tabs around the full perimeter for lacing to the frame, same system as the Nuke Sunrise Custom Frame Bag.

details.fabric: printed MultiCam pattern - diamond quilt grid not distinguishable against the print; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Perimeter loop tabs, laced or zip-tied to the frame; maker copy also lists straps, lace-up, or bolt-on as options.

products.name: Gravel Banger Half Bag
products.dims_note: Custom built to each frame; no dimensions or litre figure published. dims_cm is an unchanged estimate for a typical half-frame bag, not maker data. Maker copy quotes a 12-16 week lead time.

geometry.notes: Shallow half-frame panel (top-tube-only, does not reach the BB), Realtree-pattern camo fabric. Loop tabs run along the top edge for lacing to the top tube; a straight zip runs along the panel's lower-middle for access, with one strap tab at the tail end.

details.fabric: printed Realtree camo - diamond quilt grid not distinguishable against the print; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Hangs from loop tabs along the top tube; maker copy also lists straps or bolt-on with a machined aluminium stiffener as options.
